answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 25231 Country: India Title: I have 2 daughters n now we are deciding to have a third child, but we want to have a boy,so please tell any dua or taweez used during pregnancy or before pregnancy or any salaatuntasbeeh or wazifa.. Question: ASSALAMUALAIKUM..I have 2 daughters n now we are deciding to have a third child, but we want to have a boy,so please tell any dua or taweez used during pregnancy or before pregnancy or any salaatuntasbeeh or wazifa..but please write the dua in arabic version as well in english ..please reply soon Answer ID: 25231 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1692/1324/B=1431) Recite the following dua extensively and supplicate Allah Almighty, in-sha-Allah your desire shall be fulfilled: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ [الأنبياء : 89] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
